analysis:
No patch hunks were supplied. I could only inspect base lines 592-1243 and head lines 1-590 of .github/workflows/release-swift.yml. The two excerpts do not overlap, so no like-for-like comparison was possible and I report no regression. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety.

Head lines 1-590 show source trust gating before any credentials are used. resolve-env checks out master and runs provider-release-resume.py verify-source (lines 175-181). Builds and qualification check out steps.trust.outputs.source_sha (workflow_sha). The signing job fetches the unsigned artifact, unpacks it with a source SHA and version check (lines 378-398), and requires an embedded provisioning profile (aps-environment=production, keychain group, expiry). The bundle writes the app-attest-callback-v1 marker (line 523), and a pre-sign runtime-smoke checks the Gemma, app-attest, qwen4 and build-environment markers (lines 568-581).

Base lines 592-1243 show the signed pipeline:
- Entitlements come from prepare-app-attest-entitlements.py, with aps-environment=production required and get-task-allow absent (lines 657-668).
- Notarization, stapling, and cmp checks that the flat bin/ files match the app executables (lines 746-755).
- The final smoke on the extracted tarball records BINARY_HASH and the full CodeDirectory SHA-256 (lines 862-869), checks the linked SDK, and asserts that the fan helper is absent from the flat layout and present under Helpers/.
- Validation-only runs retain a signed artifact with release_published=false.
- Publish runs retain a publication artifact. stage-release and publish-release download it by artifact id and digest, and publish-release registers it with the coordinator under a per-environment concurrency group (lines 1079-1187).

These touch A-011, A-017, T-034 and T-054. The next pass should compare the two sides on the same line ranges and check three things. First, whether the CodeDirectory hash and the publication payload/provenance still reach coordinator registration. Second, whether the resume path (provider-release-resume.py) still verifies artifact id and digest. Third, whether the fan-helper layout checks still hold.
